goalSummary: Token usage records show as zero or missing for a run despite the agent task having executed and completed normally.

facts.why: The span lifecycle scripts controlling measurement start/stop must be named
The SQLite store for token-per-call records must be identified
The task_id naming format must be documented for cross-agent grouping
The deduplication strategy across worktrees must be documented as the cause of silent discards
The .data/ directory being git-ignored and local-only must be documented, explaining why data doesn't transfer across machines
Fix: the env vars that must be exported for token counts to be captured must be named
